title: Clean Highlighter Blender Brush
descriptionHtml:
What it is: An essential blending brush with a flat shape for even color dispersion—the ideal companion to Super Loaded Tinted Highlight (sold separately).

What Else You Need to Know: Luxurious and durable, each brush is handmade in Japan by the most prestigious brush maker in the world, using cruelty-free, super-soft nylon fibers and sustainably sourced birch. Thoughtfully designed shorter handles make for an easy, effortless application.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Starting at the base of your cheekbones, apply with a sweeping motion.
-This unique brush will naturally guide your hand upward, leaving your skin looking polished and refined.
-Gently clean your brush with mild soap and water.

Gucci Westman's tip:
-"Brushes are my most important tools. I think of them as an extension of myself, and it’s an absolute luxury to work with an extraordinary brush."—Gucci Westman, Westman Atelier founder
